credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-built in tools/art/species_f/ (Round 4). Subject: Malus domestica (orchard apple); drawn from its botany, not traced from any photo.

source.from: base art before the Crystal-rule rollout

notes: LOOMING: S-twisted gnarled trunk, wide low crown hunched over the foe, the lead bough sagging with apples, blossom on top, an apple dropping. Accent: the wine apple skin (dark slot). Sport: Malus 'Royalty' (purple-leaved crabapple: bronze-purple leaves, crimson-pink blossom, dark fruit).
